name: What are the signs of subfloor damage in a mobile home?

mainEntity.name: What are the signs of subfloor damage in a mobile home?

acceptedAnswer.text: Signs of subfloor damage in a mobile home often include soft, spongy, or sagging spots in the floor, especially near appliances, bathrooms, or exterior walls. You might also notice unusual noises like creaking when walking, lifting of flooring materials, or visible water stains. Addressing subfloor damage promptly is crucial to prevent further structural issues and ensure safety.
acceptedAnswer.description: Signs of subfloor damage include soft or sagging floor spots, creaking, lifting flooring, or water stains, often near wet areas.
